arm_spec._note: The full MuSiQue training split, no cap and no hop filter.

prompt._note: The training prompt is built from the SAME per-model prompt file the prompting arm uses (components/decomposer/models/<model>/), with the few-shot block empty: the fine-tuned arm is meant to answer zero-shot, and inference must see the string shape training saw (run_decomposer.py --adapter ... --no-few-shot). target_reference_style 'as_is' trains on the gold step text verbatim; 'bracketed' rewrites '#1' to '[#1]' to match the convention the prompt file states. The choice is not neutral and is Jahid's to make: the evaluator strips brackets before matching steps (so exact-match and step-F1 are unaffected), but reference_validity_micro is vacuously 1.0 for predictions with no [#k] references, and ROUGE-L tokenises before punctuation stripping, so '#1' and '[#1]' are different tokens there.
prompt._unguided_hop_placeholder_note: Not duplicated here: it is read from decomposer_config below, so the training prompt and the inference prompt cannot drift apart on it.

loader._note: Base-model loading for training. QLoRA is the 4bit path (bitsandbytes NF4 + double quantization); 'none' loads in dtype. device_map 'auto' needs accelerate.

lora._note: target_modules are the attention/MLP projection names of Llama/Mistral-family models. A different base architecture uses different names, so this list is a config value, not a default buried in code; peft raises if a name is absent.

training._note: trl SFTConfig fields. The dataset is prompt/completion typed and completion_only_loss masks the prompt out of the loss, so the model is trained on the decomposition text only. Batch 1 x grad-accum 16 with gradient checkpointing and max_length 1024 is what keeps a 4-bit 7B base inside 24 GiB on the RTX 3090 of docs/compute.md - an estimate until a run measures peak_gpu_memory_bytes, which the metrics JSON records. bf16 is supported on Ampere.
training._warmup_note: warmup_steps, not warmup_ratio: transformers 5.5.4 warns that warmup_ratio is deprecated and slated for removal, so the run would emit a deprecation warning and eventually break.
